entities.name: Riku of Two Reflections
entities.description: Legendary human wizard of Shandalar who split himself into two reflections to master spellcraft and the study of life.

entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: Plane Riku travelled to through an Omenpath.

entities.name: Omenpath
entities.description: Path between planes used by Riku.

events.summary: Riku split himself into two reflections via an ancient illusionist's spell, each studying a different field.
events.quote: he secretly split himself into two reflections

events.summary: Riku travelled through an Omenpath to Thunder Junction to hone his magic.
events.quote: Riku found his way through an Omenpath to Thunder Junction
